declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 if :INSTR_TESTS.eff_date is null then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 --
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 --
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED') then
 -- Added by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 
 if trunc(:INSTR_TESTS.eff_date) < trunc(v_local_time) then -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 04/25/2011. IM 5318
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if trunc(:INSTR_TESTS.term_date) < trunc(:INSTR_TESTS.eff_date) then
 show_error ('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
end;

select vi.test_id test_id,substr(test_desc,1,30), test_short_id, test_group from valid_instrument_tests vi, valid_tests v where 
lower(vi.chapter_id) = lower(:global.chapter_id) and 
machine_id = :ctrl_block_1.machine_id and vi.test_id = v.test_id and /* Timezone changes by Kishore on 05/20/2015. IM 45 */ lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) /* End of changes */ between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date, sysdate + 365) and 
(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate) ) between trunc
(v.eff_date) 
and nvl(trunc(v.term_date),trunc(Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time
(:global.chapter_id,sysdate)+1))
 order by vi.test_id
